name: mobile-manifest-check
description: Mobile manifest check: before a release, reads an Android AndroidManifest.xml with its network security config and FileProvider paths, and an iOS Info.plist, and reports dangerous and restricted permissions, android:debuggable, allowBackup, cleartext traffic, user certificates, exported components without a permission, missing android:exported, broad provider paths, missing, empty or placeholder usage descriptions and App Transport Security exceptions, each mapped to its OWASP MASVS control. Text, JSON and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, a safe XML reader that expands no entity, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
